commands.command: set -u; echo '=== USBMODEM NODES ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbmodem* /dev/tty.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== USBSERIAL NODES (names only, not opened) ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbserial* /dev/tty.usbserial* 2>/dev/null || true; count=0; chosen=''; for p in /dev/cu.usbmodem*; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; count=$((count+1)); chosen="$p"; done; echo USBMODEM_COUNT=$count; [ "$count" -eq 1 ] && echo C6_CANDIDATE=$chosen || true
